Container.Name: nomad-mysql
Container.Overview: MySQL 8.0 database for Project N.O.M.A.D. (nomad_admin). Install this before nomad_admin.[br][br] Runs only on the project-nomad_default network, with no ports published to your LAN. Create the network first: [code]docker network create project-nomad_default[/code][br][br] MYSQL_PASSWORD must equal DB_PASSWORD in the nomad_admin template. The passwords only take effect the first time the data folder is initialized; changing them later needs a fresh data folder or a manual change inside MySQL.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: MySQL data files. A cache/pool path such as /mnt/cache/appdata/... performs better than /mnt/user.

Config.Name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Root password for MySQL. Pick a strong random value.

Config.Name: MYSQL_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for the NOMAD database user. Must match DB_PASSWORD in nomad_admin.
